text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. You are here because you have a fever and abdominal tenderness after giving birth; can you tell me exactly how many days postpartum you are and what your temperature has been?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis (likely complicated by postpartum urinary retention).

I have noted your history of a prolonged labor, which is a major risk factor, along with your urinary frequency and decreased bowel sounds suggesting bladder distension. Before we proceed, can you confirm if you have experienced any foul-smelling vaginal discharge or if the urination frequency is accompanied by a burning sensation?
